title: Accepted Answers + a leaner extension platform
notes: New free Accepted Answers extension in the Marketplace — mark a category as Q&A and let the asker or staff mark a reply as the accepted answer (green check, thread shows solved). It's opt-in: nothing changes unless you install it and flag a category. Under the hood, extensions can now add controls to a post's action row and transform post content, so more features ship as small installable add-ons instead of bloating core.

changelog.text: Accepted Answers extension (free, opt-in): mark a reply as the solution in Q&A categories.
Extension platform: a post-action slot + a content render hook so features can be add-ons, not core.
